narration: Your brain is editing your memories right now.
caption: YOUR BRAIN IS EDITING\nYOUR MEMORIES

narration: And you probably don't even realize it's happening.
caption: YOU DON'T EVEN\nREALIZE IT

narration: When you remember something, your brain doesn't simply replay a recording.
caption: MEMORY IS NOT A RECORDING

narration: It reconstructs the memory from pieces of information.
caption: YOUR BRAIN RECONSTRUCTS IT

narration: That means every time you remember something, the memory can actually change.
caption: EVERY RECALL CAN CHANGE IT

narration: That's one reason two people can remember the same event differently.
caption: SAME EVENT. DIFFERENT MEMORY.

narration: So your memories aren't perfect recordings. They're reconstructions.
caption: YOUR MEMORIES ARE RECONSTRUCTIONS.
